finding.expected: Ensure the exact delivery is re-projected after the AIOS invocation attempt on both success and failure paths, using existing exact dispatch binding and canonical terminal state only. If RESULT or FAILURE exists for the attributed RUN, the final workflow-run receipt must be TERMINAL_POINTER; if no terminal exists, remain at the strongest actually proven nonterminal/typed failure boundary. Preserve the original command exit outcome and do not suppress or reinterpret Runtime failure.
finding.issue: The post-AIOS project_delivery_receipt call is reached only after the delegated command returns normally. When an admitted RUN terminalizes as canonical FAILURE and the AIOS command exits nonzero, the workflow receipt file can remain at the pre-call AIOS_INVOKED state written immediately before invocation. The always-run expose step then surfaces that stale receipt even though exact canonical FAILURE truth already exists, violating the terminal-pointer reduction rule.
